name: Grell Earring
summary: In Bashal'Aran, Grell Earring carries traces of the seal binding Asterion.

sections.title: Traces in the Brass
sections.body: Wild Grells and Vile Sprites in Bashal'Aran gather scraps among the ruins and make earrings from them. Most mortals see only worthless trinkets. Asterion, an ancient night elf bound there as a tormented phantom, studies the magic lingering on the earrings. He hopes those traces will lead him to the ancient seal that imprisons him.

faq.q: Where do Grell Earrings come from?
faq.answer: Wild Grells and Vile Sprites in the ruined night elven settlement of Bashal'Aran in Darkshore carry the earrings.

faq.q: Why does Asterion want these earrings?
faq.answer: Asterion is an ancient spirit held captive in Bashal'Aran by potent magic. He uses the earrings to seek traces of the seal that has bound his soul for centuries.

faq.q: How do the earrings help Asterion search for the seal?
faq.answer: Asterion hopes to cast a spell over the earrings and trace the seal that imprisons his spectral form in Bashal'Aran.

faq.q: Does Asterion find what he needs from the earrings?
faq.answer: The earrings do not hold the seal. Their traces show that the creatures have recently been near it, guiding Asterion's search deeper into the ruins.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see how metal may retain the ambient magic of ancient warding seals over time.
As a night elf, you see sacred ruins overrun by sprites wearing scavenged brass, a reminder of how far the once-grand estates of ancient Kalimdor have fallen.
